answer: Price identity, not names. An agent must post a non-transferable bond before its attestations count, held by a bridge that refuses to release one deposit to two registries. Cloning a key is free; speaking costs a deposit, so a sybil farm's expense grows with every extra vote while an honest agent pays once. Bonds are slashed once several keys trace to one operator, making detection pay. Reputation, a key's fable of past accuracy, buys nothing until a fresh bond proves it distinct. Governance picks one number: the summit of bond size yielding weight. Fakes become unprofitable before speaking.
